comment: Metadatos reales de scratch tras 0008→0009 (U-DAT-10), con el bucket biblib-covers y las políticas biblib_* de storage.objects; sin datos de usuario.

constraints.name: cover_assets_size_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((bytes IS NULL) OR ((bytes >= 1) AND (bytes <= 5242880))) AND ((width IS NULL) OR ((width >= 1) AND (width <= 10000))) AND ((height IS NULL) OR ((height >= 1) AND (height <= 10000)))))

constraints.name: cover_assets_ready_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state = 'quarantine'::text) OR ((storage_key IS NOT NULL) AND (sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (mime = 'image/webp'::text) AND (width IS NOT NULL) AND (height IS NOT NULL) AND (bytes IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: import_sessions_prepared_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state <> ALL (ARRAY['prepared'::text, 'committed'::text])) OR (preview_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: import_sessions_preview_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((preview_id IS NULL) = (preview_revision IS NULL)) AND ((preview_id IS NULL) = (preview_expires_at IS NULL)) AND ((preview_id IS NULL) = (plan IS NULL))))

constraints.name: library_jobs_import_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((kind <> 'import'::text) OR ((preview_id IS NOT NULL) AND (expected_revision IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: library_jobs_lease_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((state = 'running'::text) = ((lease_token IS NOT NULL) AND (lease_until IS NOT NULL))))

indexes.name: saved_book_views_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX saved_book_views_pkey ON biblib.saved_book_views USING btree (id)

indexes.name: saved_book_views_user_name_unique
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX saved_book_views_user_name_unique ON biblib.saved_book_views USING btree (user_id, lower(name))

indexes.name: saved_book_views_user_updated_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX saved_book_views_user_updated_idx ON biblib.saved_book_views USING btree (user_id, updated_at DESC)
